<role>

</role>
<definition>

Compare the problem itself, not the product area. A spike that is unstarted or in progress is not shipped.
Fail if a completed story solves the same problem, or a roadmap item already covers it.
The evidence is the problem statement and the five most similar stories and roadmap pages, with status and dates.
</definition>

response.content: {"critique": "I checked whether the problem of tracking supplier communications, tasks, and performance across regions plus lacking reserves visibility is already solved or covered. The five similar items don't match: story 4136 (supplier address fields) is started but not completed and addresses address formats, not tracking/visibility; story 4138 (organisation settings) is unstarted and covers different scope; the Notion 'Claims timeline' and 'Task overview' pages cover claim tracking and task dashboards, not supplier coordination or reserves; completed story 4131 (workspace administration) solves permissions/settings, not this problem. No completed story or roadmap item covers the core problem.", "verdict": "pass"}
